purpose: 爆款候选发现，非爆款认证

collection.preferred_route: 平台实际支持的热度/点赞/播放排序；综合排序须注明不能视为热榜
collection.supplement_route: 不默认新增入口，需按实际平台方案记录

platform_routes.douyin: ONE_WEEK + MOST_LIKE; exact timestamps checked locally; rolling platform boundary may differ slightly
platform_routes.bilibili: MOST_CLICK with explicit epoch bounds derived from shared anchor
platform_routes.xiaohongshu: 关键词搜索；优先实际可用的视频类型、最近一周、最多点赞选项；记录实际筛选状态，缺失选项不声称已启用；Python复核日期

collection.quota_rule: All three platforms use configured keywords, target 20 per keyword and 60 unique complete records per platform; shortfalls may use other configured keywords, never exceed platform target.

completeness.incomplete_action: discard; aggregate reasons only; no pending pool
completeness.precision_rule: Exact integers or original approximate display; publication timestamp or supported date; uncertain age stays ungrouped; edited-only dates rejected
